subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, or defer this until broader Gateway identity/accounting design exists?
rationale: Current usage telemetry has session/agent/provider/channel dimensions but no trusted user subject, and exposing per-user cost/activity data changes the security and billing boundary.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity/accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs, diagnostics, and UI.

options.title: Plugin/Telemetry First
options.body: Keep core views as-is and use plugin or Prometheus/OpenTelemetry exports for custom dashboards until the core identity boundary is settled.

options.title: Defer Until Multi-Principal Design
options.body: Leave the issue open but block implementation until Gateway principal and per-message attribution semantics are designed more broadly.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity/accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs, diagnostics, and UI.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest observed history across usage summaries, shared usage/auth helpers, and the security-sensitive core boundary this feature requires.
